description: Abstract class for handling REST API requests in the OrangeHRM installer module, providing a template for executing HTTP methods with exception handling and JSON response formatting.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerRestController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for handling REST API requests in the installer module, providing a common execute method with exception handling and placeholder methods for HTTP verbs.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to process incoming HTTP requests, decode JSON content, route to specific handlers based on method, handle exceptions, and return JSON responses.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling GET requests; throws NotImplementedException by default.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling POST requests; throws NotImplementedException by default.

methods.name: handlePut
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling PUT requests; throws NotImplementedException by default.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling DELETE requests; throws NotImplementedException by default.
